title: PUT /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/remote-pin (body)
description: Remote PIN of the device (Fern-PIN): exactly 8 digits, stored as PBKDF2 (fixtures/crypto/settings-pin-vectors); null removes it. Never part of a profile, never logged. Rule app_settings = pin needs it (else hidden, prerequisite_missing). With a fixed profile PIN setting a device PIN answers 422 remote_pin.fixed; removing is always allowed.
